description:
The parent a consuming Spring Boot project inherits. It carries everything airness-parent carries,
        and adds the Spring version set and the rules that only a Spring Boot project can break.

        A project states which kind it is by which parent it names, rather than by a switch. That is what
        keeps the Spring relaxations off every project that is not a Spring Boot one, and what keeps them
        reviewable: they are a diff against the parent above rather than a second copy of it.

        Two rules are relaxed and five are added, so a project inheriting this answers to more than one
        inheriting airness-parent, never to less.
